head.label: How it works
head.title: How a channel meets its sponsor
head.lead: You apply, we choose a sponsor for your channel, and you decide whether to accept.

steps.title: You apply
steps.text: Fill out the application with a link to your channel, what it is about and your subscriber count.
steps.detail: We work with channels of 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers, and a channel under 1,000 cannot join yet.

steps.title: We choose a sponsor
steps.text: A person looks at your channel and chooses a sponsor that suits it.

steps.title: You decide
steps.text: We tell you which sponsor we have chosen, and you say yes or no. You can turn down any sponsor we suggest.
steps.detail: The sponsor approves each channel we suggest to it.

steps.title: The deal is done
steps.text: When you and the sponsor both say yes, the deal goes ahead.
steps.detail: This is the point at which our commission applies.

items.title: A reply from us
items.text: We reply within 2 working days of your application.

items.title: No searching on your side
items.text: You do not look for sponsors yourself. Finding one that suits your channel is our work.

items.title: A way to ask questions
items.text: Write to us by email at any point. The address is on the contact page.

commission.label: Commission
commission.title: What we charge, and when
commission.lead: The commission is taken from your fee, and only once a deal is done. With no deal, there is no commission.
